content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Administrative Office, District Judge, Bhadohi, dated 24 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bhadohi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Bhadohi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 40 vacancies: 4 Principal Assistant (Pradhan Sahayak), 36 Senior Assistant (Varishth Sahayak).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Bhadohi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format (Aavedan Praroop) on page 2 of the notice) and send it to Administrative Office, District Judge, Bhadohi, by submitted at the administrative office, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is age of 65 years not completed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Principal of last pay drawn minus amount of pension for Principal Assistant (Pradhan Sahayak), Principal of last pay drawn minus amount of pension for Senior Assistant (Varishth Sahayak).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Open only to employees retired from district courts who have not completed 65 years of age; posts filled according to qualification (no specific educational qualification printed). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only employees retired from district courts may apply. Applicant declares being fully healthy and capable of work. Applicant declares that no criminal case is pending or registered against him or her.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees who have completed 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is purely temporary, for one year. May end earlier, or when the post is filled by promotion or direct recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: District Court, Bhadohi.
